one_liner: Customer service and agentic commerce platform providing a REST API and webhook integrations for customer support workflows.
access_notes: API access requires an active Gladly paid organization account and an agent user with the API User permission.
verdict_reason: Gladly provides public REST API documentation and sandbox environments, but requires a paid subscription and specific user permissions to generate functional credentials.

evidence.snippet: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
First, you'll need to set up an account with the necessary API permissions.
Your sandbox environment is accessible at https://{organization}.gladly.qa
Gladly's REST API reference groups its operations under 21 resources, from Agents and Answer Management to Topics and Webhooks.
Gladly has a full REST API (version 1.0), but no official MCP server (checked 20 Oct 2026).
